title: Weekly sync — serving-runtime / infra / console — agenda + prep (2026-09-14)
body:
Prep notes for weekly cross-team sync. Focus for this week: production rollout for kv-cache improvements, infra autoscaling regression, and console telemetry gaps. Quick ask: come with status on assigned action items (marked below) and any blockers. If you can, paste short one-line updates into the #serving-runtime-sync Slack thread before the meeting to save time.

Context: recent traffic spike on 2026-09-10 exposed a tail latency regression when cross-region fallback is enabled. We rolled back the fallback rule on 2026-09-11 but still seeing increased 95p during sustained loads. KV-cache patch from PR#887 should reduce repeated prefix recomputation but needs canary testing on dedicated cluster. Infra autoscaler logs show missed scale-ups for burst traffic — suspect bug in new scale-down cooldown logic. Console telemetry missing request_id in 5% of requests (frontend -> backend header drop) which blocks tracing.

Meeting goal: align on rollout timeline, confirm owners for canary and regression bisection, and capture clear action items and due dates.
agenda_items: Quick round robin: 30s status updates (each team lead)
KV-cache patch PR#887 — canary plan + metrics to watch (Priya)
Autoscaler regression — logs summary and proposed rollback vs patch (Miguel)
Console telemetry — missing request_id incidents and mitigation (Dana)
Rollout gating checklist and SLO watchlist for canary (Evan)
Open action items review and prioritization (all)
AOB: oncall handoff notes + upcoming maintenance window (Liam)
action_items: Priya: Deploy PR#887 to canary cluster (dedicated-canary-3) and enable detailed prefix-miss tracing. Due: 2026-09-16
Priya/Miguel: Define 3 key metrics for canary (95p latency, prefix-miss-rate, token-per-request CPU). Post to JIRA SRV-4821 by EOD 2026-09-14
Miguel: Roll back scale-down cooldown change on infra-canary and run 3 synthetic burst tests. Due: 2026-09-15
Dana: Patch console header passthrough to preserve request_id for proxied requests; add unit test and deploy to staging. Due: 2026-09-17
Evan: Update rollout gating checklist in Confluence (link above) to include 'request_id presence' and 'canary 95p < target'. Due: 2026-09-15
Liam: Prepare oncall runbook note for expected behaviors during canary (include who to page if 95p spikes). Due: 2026-09-16
All: Post 1-line pre-meeting status to #serving-runtime-sync Slack thread before next sync (2026-09-16 morning)
Priya: If canary looks stable by 2026-09-18, schedule gradual rollout to dedicated-prod with step-size 10% every 2 hours (notify CS + SRE).
decisions: Canary-first approach agreed for KV-cache patch (no immediate global rollout)
Rollback of autoscaler cooldown change is preferred short-term fix; long-term root cause investigation to follow
Add 'request_id presence' as a gating signal for console-related rollouts
blockers: Need detailed canary metrics wired to Grafana — currently missing prefix-miss-rate dashboard
Access: some infra logs are in a restricted project; Miguel to request temporary read access for Priya and SRE on 2026-09-14
Staging environment has older console build that doesn't include header passthrough; Dana needs a hotfix build to validate
prep_questions: Priya: do you have an ETA for the canary deployment window?
Miguel: can you reproduce missed scale-ups locally or only in cloud environment?
Dana: can the header fix be hotpatched without full frontend deploy?
All: any objections to the proposed 10% step-size rollout if canary passes?
